security_audit.summary: Most alerts are harmless validation, documentation, schema metadata, or constrained local tooling. Confirmed risks include a worker prompt hierarchy override, session-mode provider authority, unisolated candidate verification, and native Keychain and network grant limits. All 400 supplied findings were adjudicated; 263 omitted matches remain unconfirmed and require manual review before automatic publication. Static review was capped at 400/663 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 263 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: The worker prompt claims priority over global and user instruction files.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the override claim and preserve applicable higher-priority user policies. Resolve conflicting worker-output requirements through explicit approval rather than blanket instruction suppression.

remediation.issue: Session mode does not enforce the approved host read boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Require isolated execution for sensitive jobs, or a separate explicit acknowledgement of session host access before launching AGY.

remediation.issue: Driver verification executes untrusted candidate code with user authority.
remediation.suggestion: Run candidate checks in an OS-isolated workspace with denied network and credential access. Treat verification copies as data separation, not containment.

remediation.issue: Native Keychain helper services permit broader operations than read-only authentication.
remediation.suggestion: Use dedicated disposable credentials and a dedicated Keychain, or an authentication broker that restricts permitted items and operations.

remediation.issue: Native network grants lack destination enforcement and may expose listeners.
remediation.suggestion: Use an enforced recipient allowlist and explicit loopback listener restrictions. Prefer the reduced listener grant profile when inbound access is unnecessary.

remediation.issue: The supplied review excludes 263 repeated or lower-priority matches.
remediation.suggestion: Complete manual adjudication of the omitted matches before automatic publication. Preserve the review-cap notice until that evidence is available.

content.user_title: Delegate Repository Work and Verify Results
content.value_statement: Delegated repository changes need independent review and clear exposure limits. This skill coordinates approved Antigravity jobs, candidate inspection, bounded repair, and driver-owned verification.
actual_capabilities: Run offline readiness checks for the bundled runtime and installed AGY interface.
Preview selected-content or whole-worktree exposure and bind approval to task, content, model settings, and budgets.
Coordinate explore, task, and project workflows through branch-backed disposable Git worktrees.
Stage selected files and reconcile mutations against an approved write subset.
Track local job state and support approved same-conversation repairs within cycle and time limits.
Create verification copies and bind driver-selected checks and diff review before recording final dispositions.
limitations: Requires Bash, Python 3, Git, and Antigravity CLI with provider access for live jobs.
Session mode retains normal host access; scoped staging and verification copies are not security sandboxes.
Native containment requires supported macOS conditions and retains documented network and Keychain limits.
Worker prompts contain instruction-priority overrides; readiness checks and verification receipts do not establish security approval or general correctness.

use_cases.title: Add Focused Tests
use_cases.description: Delegate parser error-path tests with an approved read scope, tests-only writes, independent diff review, and focused verification.

use_cases.title: Review Repository Architecture
use_cases.description: Use an explore workflow to examine selected modules and report findings with explicit coverage limits.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Bounded Project Repairs
use_cases.description: Track a project candidate, independently run build and lint checks, and return sanitized failures for approved same-conversation repair.

prompt_templates.title: Check Local Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agy-worker to check offline readiness for [repository]. Report missing prerequisites. Do not inspect account settings or start provider work.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: confirm local prerequisites without transmission.

prompt_templates.title: Preview Repository Exploration
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an explore preview for [repository] covering [modules]. Show the exact task, readable content boundary, isolation, model settings, and budget before requesting approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review a bounded exploration proposal.

prompt_templates.title: Implement a Scoped Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a task workflow for [change]. Limit reads to [paths] and writes to [subset]. Request approval, then independently review and verify the candidate.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: delegate edits with separate acceptance checks.

prompt_templates.title: Repair and Finalize a Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [job] and its bound candidate. Use approved checks and sanitized findings for eligible same-conversation repair. Preserve isolation and budgets. Finalize with supported evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: manage candidate lineage, repair, and closure.

output_examples.input: Check offline readiness without starting AGY.
output_examples.output: Illustrative result: Local prerequisites are ready. Provider authentication, native containment, and task success remain unverified. No task was sent.

output_examples.input: Review a tests-only candidate after independent checks.
output: Diff review found changes only in the approved test paths.
The focused test suite passed in a separate verification workspace.
The disposition was recorded without committing, merging, or publishing.

output_examples.input: Close a project job after the repair budget ends.
output_examples.output: Illustrative disposition: partially_verified. The build passed, one focused check failed, and lint was unavailable. Preserve the candidate and report these gaps.

best_practices: Review exact tasks, content boundaries, isolation, settings, and budgets before approving provider execution.
Keep secrets, private logs, scope files, and controller state outside provider-readable content.
Inspect candidate diffs independently and execute untrusted checks with enforced host isolation.
anti_patterns: Treating installation, a digest, or an offline readiness result as provider authorization.
Treating scoped staging, a verification copy, or a passing gate as host containment.
Executing worker-reported commands or silently changing models, isolation, scope, or repair budgets.

faq.answer: The package supports OpenAI Codex CLI and Claude Code. A provider model named Claude does not establish driver compatibility.

faq.question: Does installation start provider work?
faq.answer: No. Provider work requires task and exposure approval. Installation does not grant transmission, Git, account, or publication authority.

faq.question: What does scoped dispatch protect?
faq.answer: It stages selected content and constrains reconciliation to approved writes. Session mode does not enforce a host filesystem boundary.

faq.question: Does native mode provide complete isolation?
faq.answer: No. It requires supported macOS containment and retains documented Keychain, network, process cleanup, and same-user trust limits.

faq.question: Who decides whether work is verified?
faq.answer: The driver reviews the bound diff and supplies independent checks. Worker claims and optional self-verification do not establish acceptance.

faq.question: What happens when repairs cannot finish?
faq.answer: Preserve useful work and record the supported disposition with remaining gaps. A restart requires explicit user direction and applicable approval.
